{{Quote|I don't know why this Jedi's been interfering with my operations&mdash;or what happened to the bounty hunter who's supposed to keep him out of my fur!&mdash;but it ends here!|Akris Ur'etu gives orders to his men|<ref name="Rep" />}}
'''Akris Ur'etu''' was a wealthy [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who, at a relatively young age, became head of the criminal organization known as the [[Skar'kla Consortium]]. The consortium had several [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] rivals, one of whom arranged for an [[Unidentified Hutt enforcer|enforcer]] to dress as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and interfere with Skar'kla operations before hunting down and [[Death/Legends|killing]] the Bothan without anyone suspecting the Hutts. Ur'etu hired the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to stop the imposter; Bane, however, allowed the hunter to find and kill Ur'etu using several pieces of technology designed to mimic [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|abilities]].<ref name="Rep" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|Look, I don't know what grudge you have against my organization, but I'm sure there's some arrangement that we can... glrk...|Akris Ur'etu's last words.|<ref name="Rep" />}}
Akris Ur'etu was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who gained control of the criminal syndicate known as the [[Skar'kla Consortium]] at a fairly young age. Whilst he controlled the consortium, several [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] attempted to take over portions of its territory. Shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], one of the Hutts hired an [[Unidentified Hutt enforcer|enforcer]] to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Ur'etu while disguised as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] so as to draw suspicion away from the Hutt and onto the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

The Jedi imposter first interfered in a number of Skar'kla operations, which caused Ur'etu to hire the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to kill the man whom he believed to be a real Jedi. The imposter, however, tracked down the Bothan to a Skar'kla base and attacked him. Ur'etu managed to take cover inside the building with a number of thugs and sealed its [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]]. The false Jedi, however, cut through them with a stolen [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and killed several thugs with a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] before finishing off the rest with the lightsaber.

While the imposter and thugs fought, Ur'etu managed to escape through a hidden passageway concealed behind his [[Greel wood/Legends|Greel wood]] desk. The passage lead to the base's security center where he was greeted by his [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] security chief. The pair prepared to battle the imposter together, but the assassin used a mono-filament cable with a magnetic grapple to pull the crime lord's [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] from his grasp, as though using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and then used it to shoot and kill the Weequay. Ur'etu attempted to plead for his life, but the imposter released gas from an emitter on his wrist, which began to choke the Bothan&mdash;to the crime lord, it seemed as though he being killed through the Force. Bane, who had been watching the entire encounter from afar, then arrived in the security center but, to Ur'etu's horror, told the imposter he could finish his job and allowed the Bothan to choke to [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Rep" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|All right. Then here's the deal, son. I took Ur'etu's job&mdash;that's killing you, in case you weren't sure&mdash;because I figured taking down a Jedi would garner some attention.|Cad Bane, after allowing his former employer to be killed|<ref name="Rep" />}}
Bane had only taken the job from Ur'etu due to his interest in the Jedi imposter's equipment. After Ur'etu was dead, Bane quickly defeated the imposter and then made an agreement with him, allowing him to live if he would show the Duros how to make each piece of equipment. Bane also demanded that the imposter allow him to collect the bounty on Ur'etu, as it would be high, and he desired the reputation boost that would come with it.<ref name="Rep" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Blast doors down! Blast doors down!|Akris' terrifed command as the imposter pursued him|<ref name="Rep" />}}
Ur'etu was greatly scared of the Jedi imposter while being pursued. He could not conceal his fear from others, as his [[gray]] and [[brown]] fur stood on end and his voice changed pitch whenever he felt afraid. While being chased, he swore continuously in [[Bothese]] and once the imposter corned him he begged to make an arrangement with him to spare his life. Ur'etu's fear was replaced by anger on occasion; first at the Jedi as he attempted to enter the compound, then at the ineptitude of his Weequay security chief and finally as he died at Cad Bane for letting him be killed.<ref name="Rep" />

==Behind the scenes==
Akris Ur'etu first appeared in the short story ''[[Reputation (Cad Bane)|Reputation]]'', written by [[Ari Marmell]] and drawn by [[Tom Hodges|Thomas Hodges]] which was published in [[Star Wars Insider 136]] in [[2012]]. The story states that he has shadow [[gray]] colored fur although in both illustrations of him it appears [[brown]].
